name: secret_put
description: Store or update a secret in z-mist. The plaintext value in 'encryptedValue' is encrypted with AES-256 server-side before being written to MySQL. Backed by POST /api/secret (create) or PUT /api/secret (update). To decide which: the controller's POST treats it as new save, PUT treats as update. Note: 'plainValue' is the conceptual name — the actual JSON body field is 'encryptedValue' (the controller will encrypt whatever you pass). To UPDATE, pass the existing secretKey+group+namespace; the value is replaced and a new version (v1, v2, ...) is recorded in z_mist_secret_history. ZMistApplication runs on port 8080.

secretKey.description: Unique key identifier. Example: 'db_password'. Combined with (group, namespace) forms the natural key.

appName.description: Application this secret belongs to, e.g. 'z-biz-news', 'z-biz-game-2048-ios'. Optional but recommended for auditing.

encryptedValue.description: The plaintext secret value. Sent over HTTPS, encrypted server-side with AES-256, never stored in cleartext. The caller should NOT log this value.

encryptAlgorithm.description: Encryption algorithm. Default AES. RSA is currently a stub (see FEATURE021 §决策 5) and behaves as AES.

secretType.description: Type of secret. Default 'text'. Use 'cert' for TLS certs, 'token' for OAuth/JWT, 'password' for DB creds.

expireTime.description: Optional ISO 8601 expiration, e.g. '2026-12-31T23:59:59'. After this time the secret should be rotated. P1 feature: auto-alerting on expiry.

description.description: Free-text note about what this secret is for. Helps future auditors understand intent.
